rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); capture-primitives: capture_view, the smart capture, takes the text raster policy render_to_png and render_to_png_gpu already take and hands it to whichever Skia backend it chooses, defaulting to legacy so existing callers capture byte-identically. pulp-screenshot passes a script's requested policy on --backend auto as it already did on an explicit backend. No backend selection, content floor, or overlay rule changes. Vellum inherits the policy-carrying smart capture with the capture primitives.
tests: build/test/pulp-test-browser-capture-import "the smart capture renders with the text raster policy it is given"
